description_en: Performs model prediction, which includes three types: long document information extraction, single receipt information extraction, and table information extraction
description_zh: 模型预测分为三种类型：长文档信息抽取、单票据信息抽取、表格信息抽取
name: PredictModel

parameters.help_en: The URL for accessing the image or PDF file
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: The version number of the model. If this parameter is not specified, the latest effective version of the model is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 模型对应的版本号，如果不传入版本号表示默认用模型最新生效的版本
parameters.name: model_version

parameters.help_en: The model ID. You can obtain the model ID from the model list page
parameters.name: model_id

parameters.example:
false：表示content传入的是url
true：表示body是直接传入图片进行base64的内容
parameters.help_en: Set to false when the Content field contains an image URL. Set to true when the Body field contains Base64-encoded content
parameters.help_zh:
content字段是图片URL时：false
body为base64的内容时：true
parameters.name: binary_to_text

parameters.help_en: The Base64 encoding content of the image
parameters.name: body

Code.description_en: The status of the request result. A value of 200 indicates success
